Принцип его действия достаточно прост. В: Its principle of operation is quite simple. The rotation of the engine shaft is transmitted via a transmission to the governor shaft. During the rotation of the governor shaft, the weights deflect from the axis under the action of centrifugal force; the faster the shaft rotates, the further the weights spread apart. The levers interact with a clutch and move it along the shaft axis. Through a system of levers, the clutch displacement is transmitted to the steam supply throttle valve so that when the shaft speed increases, the supply decreases, and when it decreases, the supply increases.
